_schema.description: Locality (suburb/town) and postcode lookup for site search. Built by intersecting Vicmap Admin polygons (locality_polygon, postcode_polygon) with the state district boundaries (state_assembly_2022, the 2021 redivision used in 2026). The VEC publishes no downloadable locality-to-district list; its lookup is address-based. A locality or postcode can straddle districts; shares are by land area, not population, so check the VEC's lookup for a specific address.

fields.min_share: Smallest area share kept for a district
fields.localities: [{n: locality name, p: [postcodes overlapping it], d: [[district id, area share 0-1], ...] largest first}]
fields.postcodes: [{p: postcode, d: [[district id, area share 0-1], ...] largest first}]

source: Vicmap Admin (locality_polygon, postcode_polygon, state_assembly_2022) via opendata.maps.vic.gov.au, © State of Victoria (DEECA), CC BY 4.0
